invariants: one add call resolves, stages, and requests the exact protected workspace review; UI and agents use the same method
staging an isolated context is not separately gated; consent belongs to the exact durable protected-main publication
lineage adoption records an exact contribution baseline and generated relationship metadata without merging historical template content into the current workspace
an unchanged installed node uses its mutable current-workspace layer and descriptive contribution state without reacquiring its upstream repository
add resolves its source once and records the exact selected pins in the retained operation before mutation
templates have ordered repository contributions, never exclusive repository ownership; overlap is merged through ordinary VCS external deltas

the installed source selection is the update cursor for every already-resolved URL; catalog selections and unseen dependencies resolve from the reviewed registry revision, while direct URLs use inspect's independently discovered exact pin
pending review items are opened through normal VCS compare/merge using their context and delta ids; approval record identifiers are host-internal
an incoming change affecting migrations/<facet> is retained in the same repair context until an agent reads and verifies the living contract notes; no applied-note ledger exists
protected main owns the only build, typecheck, schema, and authority gate; failures retain the staged context and structured diagnostics for agentic repair
when protected main advances during review, the operation returns the new main event and retained context so an agent can merge main semantically and resume instead of discarding the plan
catalog rendering is cache-only; network refresh occurs only through catalog({ refresh: true })
a catalog selection is rejected unless registryCommit and registrySnapshot exactly match the cached verified registry
excluded trust/provider values are optional hints and are not proactively presented after install; when later relevant they use a separate protected settings action
status is a local projection of descriptive relationship state and content-addressed suggestion decisions; it never acquires or fetches template sources
a direct URL may name a logical credential; that name is preserved in inspect.pin and durable operation intent
the userland composer resolves every URL or revision-bound catalog id to an exact version before inspection or approval; there is no host fallback
authoring dependencies are URL-only semantic relationships; they need not be installed or controlled by the author and exact release coordinates are not authoring inputs

authoring inspections bind selected and automatically required repositories, generated manifest, and protected-main event; installed contribution relationships are explanatory hints only and publication rejects stale fingerprints
template publication creates one external repository with main and the immutable version tag at the same commit; it does not assign workspace ownership or imply registry promotion

registry suggestion requires the complete unchanged publication and non-stale verified catalog receipts, writes one validated registry document on a collision-safe branch based on the reviewed registry commit, and never merges or promotes it
